thesis: The site is the chimney: scrolling is the brush climbing the flue, each section one level of the cross-section, brightening from firebox-dark to cap-daylight.

signature.name: flue-level
signature.summary: Drawn chimney cross-section in left margin (desktop) or top rail (mobile) with six labelled levels (Firebox·Damper·Smoke shelf·Liner·Crown·Cap); a brush marker climbs via --sw-p as sections enter view. Reused in hero arch frame, process story wipe, service level tags, review hang-points, estimator rows and footer cap.

motion.intro: Ember glow warms inside the arch (800ms), photo fades in behind (400ms), h1 line-mask reveals upward with 70ms stagger.
stories: Brush marker rises through drawn flue while soot wipes clean via clip-path driven by --sw-p; pinned ≥640px, stacked cards below.
